## Summary

## Verification

- [ ] `dotnet format` verification passes.
- [ ] Windows Release build and all tests pass.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No Token, pairing URL/QR, private path/IP, raw payload, prompt/response, config/event/hook data, diagnostic archive, key, certificate secret, or build output is committed.
- [ ] Network, storage, permissions, and dependency changes are explained.
- [ ] Existing Codex `notify` remains untouched.
